notablePrerequisites:
Lightning Greaves attached to Llanowar Druid.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other nontoken creatures.
description:
Activate at least three nontoken creatures you control except Othelm and Llanowar Druid by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Llanowar Druid by tapping and sacrificing it.
Holding priority, activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Llanowar Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Llanowar Druid ability, untapping all Forests.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Llanowar Druid.
Repeat.
